R1Z/SimCostRelativeReplay.name: queryBytes_log
R1Z/SimCostRelativeReplay.statement:
theorem queryBytes_log (O : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (p : OProg) (q : Nat) :
    queryBytes O p q = ((runLog p O q).map (fun row => row.1.length)).sum

R1Z/SimCostRelativeReplay.name: lookup_bytes
R1Z/SimCostRelativeReplay.statement:
theorem lookup_bytes (a : List UInt8) (t : Table) (L : Nat) (ht : KeysBound L t) :
    (lookup a t).2 ≤ (t.length+1)*(a.length+L+3)

R1Z/SimCostRelativeReplay.name: replay_bytes
R1Z/SimCostRelativeReplay.statement:
theorem replay_bytes (t : Table) (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (p : OProg) (q L : Nat)
    (ht : KeysBound L t) :
    (replay t H p q).2 ≤ (t.length+1) *
      (queryBytes (fun a => (t.lookup a).getD (H a)) p q + q*(L+6))

R1Z/SimCostRelativeReplay.name: replay_relative
R1Z/SimCostRelativeReplay.statement:
theorem replay_relative (t : Table) (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (p : OProg) (q L : Nat)
    (ht : KeysBound L t) :
    (replay t H p q).2 ≤ (t.length+1)*(L+6) *
      inputLength (fun a => (t.lookup a).getD (H a)) p q

R1Z/SimCostRelativeReplay.name: programmed_relative
R1Z/SimCostRelativeReplay.statement:
theorem programmed_relative (t : Table) (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (p : OProg) (q L : Nat)
    (ht : KeysBound L t) :
    (programmed t H p q).2 ≤ ((t.length+1)*(L+6)+2*t.length) *
      (inputLength (fun a => (t.lookup a).getD (H a)) p q + 1)

R1Z/SimCostRelativeIdeal.name: finish_relative
R1Z/SimCostRelativeIdeal.statement:
theorem finish_relative (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (s : Prepared K CommitHandle Aux) (L T : Nat)
    (hlen : s.table.length ≤ T) (hkeys : KeysBound L s.table) :
    (finish W adv s).2 ≤ relativeCoefficient 0 L T * (adversaryInput W adv s + 1)

R1Z/SimCostRelativeIdeal.name: run_relative
R1Z/SimCostRelativeIdeal.statement:
theorem run_relative (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (N : Nat) (hN : 0 < N)
    (P : Challenges K → Prop) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (C L T : Nat) (prep : Preparation W N hN P x sim C)
    (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (r : Coins (F := F) W N)
    (hs : (prepare W N hN P x sim r).table.length ≤ T ∧
      KeysBound L (prepare W N hN P x sim r).table) :
    (run W N hN P x sim C prep adv r).2 ≤ relativeCoefficient C L T *
      (adversaryInput W adv (prepare W N hN P x sim r) + 1)^1

R1Z/SimCostRelativeIdeal.name: protocol_finish_relative
R1Z/SimCostRelativeIdeal.statement:
theorem protocol_finish_relative (P : Challenges KP → Prop)
    (sim : Challenges KP → Tape KP FP → View KP CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (adv : R1Adv KP CommitHandle Aux)
    (r : (Fin 8 → R1Coins (W).Cm (W).Tab) × (Fin 8 → Tape KP FP)) :
    (finish W adv (prepare W 8 (by decide) P x sim r)).2 ≤
      relativeCoefficient 0 (RomGrammarBin.bound (R1Wire.pubBytes base x).length)
        (TranscriptR1.schedule.length + 2 * Fintype.card (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx)) *
      (adversaryInput W adv (prepare W 8 (by decide) P x sim r) + 1)^1

R1Z/SimCostRelativeIdeal.name: protocol_run_relative
R1Z/SimCostRelativeIdeal.statement:
theorem protocol_run_relative (P : Challenges KP → Prop)
    (sim : Challenges KP → Tape KP FP → View KP CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (C : Nat) (prep : Preparation W 8 (by decide) P x sim C)
    (adv : R1Adv KP CommitHandle Aux)
    (r : (Fin 8 → R1Coins (W).Cm (W).Tab) × (Fin 8 → Tape KP FP)) :
    (run W 8 (by decide) P x sim C prep adv r).2 ≤
      relativeCoefficient C (RomGrammarBin.bound (R1Wire.pubBytes base x).length)
        (TranscriptR1.schedule.length + 2 * Fintype.card (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx)) *
      (adversaryInput W adv (prepare W 8 (by decide) P x sim r) + 1)^1

R1Z/SimCostLazyCoupling.name: lazy_draws
R1Z/SimCostLazyCoupling.statement:
theorem lazy_draws (key : List UInt8 → A) (c : A → Option OracleAnswer)
    (p : OProg) (q : Nat) (u : Fin q → OracleAnswer) :
    (lazyRun key c p q u).2 ≤ q

R1Z/SimCostLazyCoupling.name: mean_update
R1Z/SimCostLazyCoupling.statement:
theorem mean_update [Fintype A] (a : A) (f : (A → OracleAnswer) → ℚ) :
    mean (fun p : (A → OracleAnswer) × OracleAnswer =>
      f (Function.update p.1 a p.2)) = mean f

R1Z/SimCostLazyCoupling.name: mean_snoc
R1Z/SimCostLazyCoupling.statement:
theorem mean_snoc {T : Type} [Fintype T] (q : Nat) (f : (Fin (q+1) → T) → ℚ) :
    mean f = mean (fun v : T => mean (fun u : Fin q → T => f (Fin.snoc u v)))

R1Z/SimCostLazyCoupling.name: mean_swap
R1Z/SimCostLazyCoupling.statement:
theorem mean_swap {S T : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype T] (f : S → T → ℚ) :
    mean (fun s => mean (f s)) = mean (fun t => mean (fun s => f s t))

R1Z/SimCostLazyCoupling.name: cached_update
R1Z/SimCostLazyCoupling.statement:
theorem cached_update (c : A → Option OracleAnswer) (H : A → OracleAnswer)
    (a : A) (v : OracleAnswer) (ha : c a = none) :
    cached c (Function.update H a v) = cached (Function.update c a (some v)) H

R1Z/SimCostLazyCoupling.name: lazy_uniform
R1Z/SimCostLazyCoupling.statement:
theorem lazy_uniform [Fintype A] (key : List UInt8 → A)
    (c : A → Option OracleAnswer) (p : OProg) (q : Nat)
    (f : List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) → ℚ) :
    mean (fun u : Fin q → OracleAnswer => f (lazyRun key c p q u).1) =
      mean (fun H : A → OracleAnswer => runLog p (fun a => cached c H (key a)) q |> f)

R1Z/SimCostRelativeObstruction.name: emit_erase
R1Z/SimCostRelativeObstruction.statement: theorem emit_erase (bs : List UInt8) : (emit bs).1 = bs

R1Z/SimCostRelativeObstruction.name: emit_cost
R1Z/SimCostRelativeObstruction.statement: theorem emit_cost (bs : List UInt8) : (emit bs).2 = bs.length

R1Z/SimCostRelativeObstruction.name: output_cost
R1Z/SimCostRelativeObstruction.statement:
theorem output_cost (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024)
    (x : Statement K Nat) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Tape K F) :
    (emit ((simE (Bat := R1Bat) π B outputs x ch t).1.publicOutputs)).2 = x.2

R1Z/SimCostRelativeObstruction.name: no_uniform_relative_metadata
R1Z/SimCostRelativeObstruction.statement:
theorem no_uniform_relative_metadata (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024)
    (pub : R0P.Public K) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Tape K F)
    (q c K0 d : Nat) :
    ∃ x : Statement K Nat,
      x.1 = pub ∧ c * (inputLength (fun _ => 0) OProg.done q + K0)^d <
        (emit ((simE (Bat := R1Bat) π B outputs x ch t).1.publicOutputs)).2

R1Z/SimCostLazyProtocol.name: mean_some
R1Z/SimCostLazyProtocol.statement:
theorem mean_some {A U : Type} [DecidableEq A] [Fintype A] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (f : (A → U) → ℚ) :
    mean (fun H : Option A → U => f (fun a => H (some a))) = mean f

R1Z/SimCostLazyProtocol.name: lazy_projection
R1Z/SimCostLazyProtocol.statement:
theorem lazy_projection {A : Type} [DecidableEq A] [Fintype A]
    (key : List UInt8 → Option A) (c : Option A → Option OracleAnswer)
    (p : OProg) (q : Nat) (f : Table → ℚ)
    (O : (A → OracleAnswer) → List UInt8 → OracleAnswer)
    (hO : ∀ H bs, cached c H (key bs) = O (fun a => H (some a)) bs) :
    mean (fun u : Fin q → OracleAnswer => f (lazyRun key c p q u).1) =
      mean (fun H : A → OracleAnswer => f (runLog p (O H) q))

R1Z/SimCostLazyProtocol.name: outside_lookup
R1Z/SimCostLazyProtocol.statement:
theorem outside_lookup (bound : Nat) (t : Table) (bs : List UInt8)
    (ht : KeysBound bound t) (hd : RomFiniteBin.decode bound bs = none) :
    t.lookup bs = none

R1Z/SimCostLazyProtocol.name: initial_oracle
R1Z/SimCostLazyProtocol.statement:
theorem initial_oracle (bound : Nat) (t : Table) (ht : KeysBound bound t)
    (H : Option (RomFiniteBin.Address bound) → OracleAnswer) (bs : List UInt8) :
    cached (initial bound t) H (RomFiniteBin.decode bound bs) =
      (t.lookup bs).getD (RomFiniteBin.lookup bound (fun a => H (some a)) bs)

R1Z/SimCostLazyProtocol.name: bounded_lazy_uniform
R1Z/SimCostLazyProtocol.statement:
theorem bounded_lazy_uniform (bound : Nat) (t : Table) (ht : KeysBound bound t)
    (p : OProg) (q : Nat) (f : Table → ℚ) :
    mean (fun u : Fin q → OracleAnswer =>
      f (t ++ (lazyRun (RomFiniteBin.decode bound) (initial bound t) p q u).1)) =
    mean (fun H : RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer =>
      f (t ++ runLog p (fun bs => (t.lookup bs).getD (RomFiniteBin.lookup bound H bs)) q))

R1Z/SimCostLazyProtocol.name: protocol_lazy_uniform
R1Z/SimCostLazyProtocol.statement:
theorem protocol_lazy_uniform (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux)
    (r : (Fin 8 → R1Coins (W).Cm (W).Tab) × (Fin 8 → Tape K F))
    (f : Table → ℚ) :
    let s := prepare W 8 (by decide) P x sim r
    mean (fun u : Fin (W).qmax → OracleAnswer =>
      f (s.table ++ (lazyRun (RomFiniteBin.decode width) (initial width s.table)
        (adv.prog s.view s.table) (W).qmax u).1)) =
    mean (fun H : RomFiniteBin.Address width → OracleAnswer =>
      f (s.table ++ runLog (adv.prog s.view s.table)
        (fun bs => (s.table.lookup bs).getD (RomFiniteBin.lookup width H bs)) (W).qmax))

R1Z/SimCostBinarySource.name: trials_bound
R1Z/SimCostBinarySource.statement:
theorem trials_bound {A : Type} (B : Nat) (u : Fin B → Option A) :
    (trials B u).2 ≤ B

R1Z/SimCostBinarySource.name: option_mean
R1Z/SimCostBinarySource.statement:
theorem option_mean {A : Type} [Fintype A] [Nonempty A] (f : Option A → ℚ) :
    mean f = rejection A * f none + (1-rejection A) * mean (fun a : A => f (some a))

R1Z/SimCostBinarySource.name: trials_law
R1Z/SimCostBinarySource.statement:
theorem trials_law {A : Type} [Fintype A] [Nonempty A] (B : Nat) (f : Option A → ℚ) :
    mean (fun u : Fin B → Option A => f (trials B u).1) =
      (rejection A)^B * f none + (1-(rejection A)^B) * mean (fun a : A => f (some a))

R1Z/SimCostBinarySource.name: word_reject
R1Z/SimCostBinarySource.statement: theorem word_reject (m : Nat) : wordEquiv m (Fin.last m) = none

R1Z/SimCostBinarySource.name: words_law
R1Z/SimCostBinarySource.statement:
theorem words_law (m : Nat) [NeZero m] (B : Nat) (f : Option (Fin m) → ℚ) :
    mean (fun u : Fin B → Fin (m+1) => f (words m B u).1) =
      (rejection (Fin m))^B * f none +
        (1-(rejection (Fin m))^B) * mean (fun a : Fin m => f (some a))

R1Z/SimCostBinarySource.name: m31_source_law
R1Z/SimCostBinarySource.statement:
theorem m31_source_law (B : Nat) (f : Option (Fin 2147483647) → ℚ) :
    mean (fun u : Fin B → Fin 2147483648 => f (words 2147483647 B u).1) =
      m31Reject^B * f none + (1-m31Reject^B) * mean (fun a : Fin 2147483647 => f (some a))

R1Z/SimCostBinarySource.name: m31_source_tail

R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.name: complete_uniform
R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.statement: theorem complete_uniform (m : Nat) [NeZero m] (B : Nat) : MP (complete m B)

R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.name: complete_agrees
R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.statement:
theorem complete_agrees (m B : Nat) (r : Source m B)
    (h : (words m B r.1).1 ≠ none) :
    (words m B r.1).1 = some (complete m B r)

R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.name: batch_uniform
R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.statement: theorem batch_uniform (m : Nat) [NeZero m] (B samples : Nat) : MP (batchComplete m B samples)

R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.name: batch_agrees
R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.statement:
theorem batch_agrees (B samples : Nat) (r : Fin samples → M31Source B) (h : ¬ bad B samples r) :
    ∀ i, (words 2147483647 B (r i).1).1 = some (batchComplete 2147483647 B samples r i)

R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.name: batch_failure_mass
R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.statement:
theorem batch_failure_mass (B samples : Nat) :
    mass (bad B samples) ≤ (samples : ℚ) * (1/(2:ℚ)^(31*B))

R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.name: eight_failure_budget
R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.statement: theorem eight_failure_budget (samples : Nat) : mass (bad 8 samples) ≤ extraMass samples

R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.name: batch_draws
R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.statement:
theorem batch_draws (B samples : Nat) (r : Fin samples → M31Source B) :
    ∑ i, (words 2147483647 B (r i).1).2 ≤ B*samples

R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.name: observer_transfer
R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.statement:
theorem observer_transfer (samples : Nat)
    (real : (Fin samples → M31Source 8) → ℚ) (ideal : (Fin samples → Fin 2147483647) → ℚ)
    (hr : ∀ r, 0 ≤ real r ∧ real r ≤ 1)
    (hi : ∀ v, 0 ≤ ideal v ∧ ideal v ≤ 1)
    (ha : ∀ r, ¬ bad 8 samples r → real r = ideal (batchComplete 2147483647 8 samples r)) :
    |mean real - mean ideal| ≤ extraMass samples

R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.name: total_source_error
R1Z/SimCostBinaryCoupling.statement:
theorem total_source_error (epsilon : ℚ)
    (he : epsilon ≤ 1/(2:ℚ)^109 + 1/(2:ℚ)^137 + 1/(2:ℚ)^454 +
      128*((2:ℚ)^25+1)/(2:ℚ)^190)
    (samples : Nat) (hs : samples ≤ 2^128) :
    epsilon + mass (bad 8 samples) < 1/(2:ℚ)^100

R1Z/SimCostTapeCoupling.name: aff_agrees
R1Z/SimCostTapeCoupling.statement:
theorem aff_agrees (r : Fin (Fintype.card Coordinates) → M31Source 8)
    (h : ¬ bad 8 (Fintype.card Coordinates) r) (i : Fin 8) (a : AffCoordinate) :
    ((words 2147483647 8 (r (Fintype.equivFin Coordinates (i,Sum.inl a))).1).1.map
      ProverCommitWordCarrier.baseEquiv) = some ((completeTapes r i).1 a)

R1Z/SimCostTapeCoupling.name: eligible_agrees
R1Z/SimCostTapeCoupling.statement:
theorem eligible_agrees (r : Fin (Fintype.card Coordinates) → M31Source 8)
    (h : ¬ bad 8 (Fintype.card Coordinates) r) (i : Fin 8) (a : EligibleCell) :
    ((words 2147483647 8 (r (Fintype.equivFin Coordinates (i,Sum.inr a))).1).1.map
      ProverCommitWordCarrier.baseEquiv) = some ((completeTapes r i).2 a)

R1Z/SimCostTapeCoupling.name: tape_source_draws
R1Z/SimCostTapeCoupling.statement:
theorem tape_source_draws (r : Fin (Fintype.card Coordinates) → M31Source 8) :
    ∑ i, (words 2147483647 8 (r i).1).2 ≤ 3342336

R1Z/SimCostTapeCoupling.name: tape_observer_transfer
R1Z/SimCostTapeCoupling.statement:
theorem tape_observer_transfer
    (real : (Fin (Fintype.card Coordinates) → M31Source 8) → ℚ)
    (ideal : (Fin 8 → Tape K F) → ℚ)
    (hr : ∀ r, 0 ≤ real r ∧ real r ≤ 1) (hi : ∀ t, 0 ≤ ideal t ∧ ideal t ≤ 1)
    (ha : ∀ r, ¬ bad 8 (Fintype.card Coordinates) r → real r = ideal (completeTapes r)) :
    |mean real - mean ideal| ≤ 1/(2:ℚ)^120

R1Z/SimCostRelativePacket.name: polynomial_eval
R1Z/SimCostRelativePacket.statement:
theorem polynomial_eval (C L T n : Nat) :
    (costPolynomial C L T).eval n = SimCostRelativeIdeal.relativeCoefficient C L T*(n+1)^1

R1Z/SimCostRelativePacket.name: polynomial_degree
R1Z/SimCostRelativePacket.statement: theorem polynomial_degree (C L T : Nat) : (costPolynomial C L T).natDegree ≤ 1

R1Z/SimCostRelativePacket.name: protocol_tape_total_error
R1Z/SimCostRelativePacket.statement:
theorem protocol_tape_total_error (epsilon : ℚ)
    (he : epsilon ≤ 1/(2:ℚ)^109 + 1/(2:ℚ)^137 + 1/(2:ℚ)^454 +
      128*((2:ℚ)^25+1)/(2:ℚ)^190) :
    epsilon + mass (bad 8 (Fintype.card Coordinates)) < 1/(2:ℚ)^100
